description: Transform a source video while preserving its structure via a spatial control signal, with the Cosmos 3 Super (64B) omni model.
inputInstructions:
Transforms a source video while preserving its structure, using a spatial control signal computed from the source (Cosmos3-Super). Select the source video as the input file; the output is an MP4 written back to the asset.

This template consumes ONE input file, so run it from a workflow whose inputFileArity is 'one' or 'multi'. The built-in "NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Super (64B)" workflow takes no input files and serves the text-only templates.

Control signal: supported types are edge, blur, depth, seg and wsm. Give several as a comma-separated list to blend them (for example `edge,blur`), and align Control weight positionally with the same commas. A blank control type means edge; a blank weight means 1.0; a blank guidance means 1.5. The control signal is auto-computed from the source video.

Metadata this template reads (all optional; file metadata wins over asset metadata):
  COSMOS3_PROMPT           What to generate. Falls back to this when the Prompt field is blank.
  COSMOS3_NEGATIVE_PROMPT  What to avoid in the output.
  COSMOS3_SEED             Integer seed; the same seed reproduces the same generation.
  COSMOS3_GUIDANCE         How strictly to follow the prompt.
  COSMOS3_NUM_FRAMES       Number of frames to generate.
  COSMOS3_CONTROL_TYPE     Control-signal type(s).
  COSMOS3_CONTROL_PATH     S3 URI of a pre-computed control video, comma-aligned to the control types.
  COSMOS3_CONTROL_WEIGHT   How strongly each control signal is applied.
  COSMOS3_CONTROL_GUIDANCE Guidance applied to the control signal.

How to supply metadata: set these on the input FILE or on the ASSET (Metadata tab, or `vamscli metadata create`). Keys are case-sensitive.

Precedence: a value you type into a field above WINS. Metadata is used only where the field is left blank, so a standing value acts as a default.

Content safety: Disable content-safety guardrails ships CHECKED, so the NVIDIA guardrail models are skipped. They load alongside the generation model and need more GPU memory than the shipped instance types provide, so they are off by default for capacity reasons. Clear the field to run them, after raising the pipeline's instanceTypes to a larger GPU tier.

tagSchema.label: Prompt
tagSchema.description: A caption describing the desired output. Leave blank to fall back to the COSMOS3_PROMPT metadata key.

tagSchema.label: Negative prompt
tagSchema.description: What to avoid in the generation. Blank falls back to COSMOS3_NEGATIVE_PROMPT metadata.

tagSchema.label: Control type
tagSchema.description: One of edge, blur, depth, seg, wsm — or a comma-separated list of them for a multi-control blend. Blank falls back to COSMOS3_CONTROL_TYPE metadata, then to edge.

tagSchema.label: Control weight
tagSchema.description: How strongly each control signal is applied, comma-aligned to the control types. Blank falls back to COSMOS3_CONTROL_WEIGHT metadata, then to 1.0.

tagSchema.label: Control guidance
tagSchema.description: Guidance applied to the control signal. Blank falls back to COSMOS3_CONTROL_GUIDANCE metadata, then to 1.5.

tagSchema.label: Disable content-safety guardrails
tagSchema.description: Checked by default, which skips the NVIDIA guardrail models. They load alongside the generation model and need more GPU memory than the shipped instance types provide, so guardrails ship off for capacity reasons. Clear this to run them, after raising the pipeline's instanceTypes to a larger GPU tier.
